# Desktop Android third-party notices

The byte-exact Hermes Desktop/shared source is MIT, Nous Research; see `hermes/LICENSE` and `hermes/source-manifest.json`. Android host adapters are project code. Electron is a **development-only type dependency** installed with scripts disabled: no Electron binary or native PC runtime is bundled into the Android renderer.

Renderer dependencies retain their own licenses. This inventory includes installed production dependency notices, including transitive packages; it is intentionally broader than the tree-shaken output. Full metadata, exact versions, source tarball URLs and notice SHA256 values are in `third-party/manifest.json`.

**noVNC 1.7.0 is MPL-2.0**, not MIT. Its unmodified source is available at https://registry.npmjs.org/@novnc/novnc/-/novnc-1.7.0.tgz and https://github.com/novnc/noVNC/tree/v1.7.0. The MPL text and bundled dependency notices are retained below. No noVNC source modifications were made. Fontsource Courier Prime and IBM Plex Mono carry their bundled OFL notices; JetBrains Mono and Collapse notices are retained with upstream assets and package notices. Marketplace-derived built-in palettes remain attributed in upstream `themes/presets.ts`.
